clipzo.welcome: Hi! I can answer questions about Clipzo, a mobile videography and cinematic reel production agency serving Mangaluru, Bengaluru, Kerala, and Vizag.

answers.question: How fast is reel delivery?
answers.answer: Same-day delivery is available on request for applicable Reel Making packages. Delivery timing depends on the selected package and production requirements.

answers.question: What packages do you offer?
answers.answer: Clipzo Reel Making packages are: Basic Reel Making Hourly ₹1,999 (1 cinematic reel shot on the latest iPhone series, 1-hour shoot on location, extra time charged at ₹500 per hour, reel duration under 60 seconds, same-day delivery available on request); Basic Reel Making Half-day ₹4,999 (1 cinematic highlights reel shot on the latest iPhone series, whole event coverage, reel duration under 90 seconds, same-day delivery available on request, one complimentary story edit); High-end Reel Making Hourly ₹3,499 (1 cinematic reel shot on the latest iPhone series, 1-hour shoot on location, extra time charged at ₹500 per hour, high-end PC editing with Premiere Pro and After Effects, reel duration under 60 seconds); and High-end Reel Making Speed Ramp ₹4,999 (1 cinematic reel shot on the latest iPhone series, 2-hour shoot on location, extra time charged at ₹500 per hour, high-end After Effects editing, reel duration under 60 seconds, one complimentary story edit).

answers.question: What is the Basic Reel Making hourly plan?
answers.answer: The Basic Reel Making Hourly Plan costs ₹1,999. It includes 1 cinematic reel shot on the latest iPhone series, 1 hour of shooting on location, extra time charged at ₹500 per hour, a reel duration under 60 seconds, and same-day delivery available on request.

answers.question: What is the Basic Reel Making half-day plan?
answers.answer: The Basic Reel Making Half-day Plan costs ₹4,999. It includes 1 cinematic highlights reel shot on the latest iPhone series, whole event coverage, a reel duration under 90 seconds, same-day delivery available on request, and one complimentary story edit.

answers.question: What is the High-end Reel Making hourly plan?
answers.answer: The High-end Reel Making Hourly Plan costs ₹3,499. It includes 1 cinematic reel shot on the latest iPhone series, 1 hour of shooting on location, extra time charged at ₹500 per hour, high-end PC editing with Premiere Pro and After Effects, and a reel duration under 60 seconds.

answers.question: What is the High-end Reel Making Speed Ramp plan?
answers.answer: The High-end Reel Making Speed Ramp Plan costs ₹4,999. It includes 1 cinematic reel shot on the latest iPhone series, 2 hours of shooting on location, extra time charged at ₹500 per hour, high-end After Effects editing, a reel duration under 60 seconds, and one complimentary story edit.

answers.question: How much is extra shooting time?
answers.answer: Extra shooting time is charged at ₹500 per hour.

answers.question: Do you travel to my location?
answers.answer: Clipzo is a mobile videography and cinematic reel production agency operating across Mangaluru, Bengaluru, Kerala, and Vizag. Travel within a 10 km radius of Mangaluru city is complimentary. Locations beyond 10 km are subject to a ₹500 travel charge. This policy applies only to shoots based in Mangaluru. Shoots in other cities or states are quoted separately.

answers.question: Is travel within 10 km of Mangaluru free?
answers.answer: Yes. Travel within a 10 km radius of Mangaluru city is complimentary.

answers.question: What is the travel charge beyond 10 km?
answers.answer: Locations beyond 10 km from Mangaluru city are subject to a ₹500 travel charge.

answers.question: What about shoots outside Mangaluru?
answers.answer: Shoots in other cities or states are quoted separately.

answers.question: What production services do you offer?

answers.answer: Traditional Videography starts at ₹7,990. It includes one cinematic edit on professional camera, raw footage on request, Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve editing, slow-mo, transitions, overlays, and professional colour grading.

answers.question: What is Candid Videography?
answers.answer: Candid Videography starts at ₹11,990. It includes one cinematic highlights edit on professional camera, raw footage on request, Premiere Pro and After Effects editing, slow-mo, transitions, overlays, and professional colour grading.

answers.question: What is Traditional Photography?

answers.question: What is Candid Photography?
answers.answer: Candid Photography starts at ₹11,990. It provides natural, story-led photography for events and celebrations.

answers.question: What is Drone Videography?

answers.question: What editing services do you offer?

Cinematic Highlight Services start at ₹4,999 and include Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve, highlights under 5 minutes, professional colour grading, smooth cuts, transitions and pacing, audio cleanup and soundtrack syncing, and cinematic slow-mo and overlays.

answers.answer: Clipzo Academy focuses on cinematic editing, camera craft, direction and story, and portfolio mentorship. Learning is guided by active filmmakers, editors, and visual storytellers.

answers.question: What is the Academy approach?

answers.question: Where is Clipzo Academy?
answers.answer: Clipzo Academy is part of the Clipzo creative world operating from Mangaluru. The website lists the Clipzo location at Shree Mangaladevi Palace, Clock Tower, Hampankatta, Mangaluru.
